query:
SELECT u.id, u.openId, u.name, u.email, u.role, u.createdAt, u.lastSignedIn, tag.tenantId, tag.workspaceRole
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN tenantAccessGrants tag ON tag.userOpenId = u.openId
WHERE LOWER(u.email) = LOWER('celiat@thechcg.com');
